category_title: Probationary high school students with severe behavioral challenges and academic resistance
scenario_title: Traditional instruction and reading in world history
minimal_context: The student is expected to read from their world history textbook during class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please open your world history textbooks and start reading the assigned chapter.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Throws a paper ball across the room) I'm not doing this work.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please stop throwing things and look at your book.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Tears a page out of the history book) Why are you teaching us bad kids?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to get through this history lesson. Please pay attention.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pours hand sanitizer on the chair and tries to set it on fire) It's an unauthorized science experiment.
